owner_posts.post_text:
This Men’s Health Month, let’s make space for conversations that feel easier to start.

Health discussions, especially around fertility and reproductive health, are often delayed because they feel confusing, uncomfortable, or overwhelming.

But clarity, openness, and understanding can make a meaningful difference. When people feel informed instead of intimidated, they are more likely to seek answers early and take confident steps towards their health.

At Nova IVF Fertility, we believe empathy begins with making every health conversation feel simple, transparent, and easier to navigate.

Male fertility is often overlooked until the journey to parenthood takes longer than expected.

But fertility is not only about sperm count. Sperm quality, including movement and overall health, can also play an important role in conception.
Advanced techniques like Microfluidics help select healthier moving sperm during IVF treatment, supporting a more personalised approach to fertility care.
This Men's Health Month, let's encourage earlier conversations, timely evaluations, and greater awareness around male fertility health.

Some dreams take a little longer to come true.

They begin as quiet hopes, become whispered prayers, and one day turn into the most beautiful reality.
This Father’s Day, we’re celebrating every dad who held on to hope, believed through the waiting, and never gave up on his dream of a family.

In IVF, precision matters at every stage.

From the collection of eggs and sperm to embryo transfer, accurate identification and verification play an important role throughout the treatment journey.

RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology adds an additional layer of electronic witnessing by assigning unique identifiers to biological samples and tracking them through key stages of the IVF process. This helps strengthen traceability and supports laboratory protocols designed to minimise the possibility of mix-ups.
At Nova IVF Fertility, RFID-based witnessing is integrated into our IVF laboratory processes as part of our commitment to maintaining high standards of safety and care.

A diagnosis of azoospermia can feel overwhelming, especially when a semen analysis shows no sperm. For many men, it may seem like the end of the road to fatherhood.

However, in some cases, sperm may still be present within the testes and can sometimes be retrieved through specialised procedures such as TESA, TESE or Micro-TESE. These retrieved sperm may then be used in IVF/ICSI treatment, offering some couples an opportunity to pursue pregnancy using their own sperm and eggs.
This Men’s Health Month, let’s remember that the right diagnosis and expert evaluation can make all the difference.

Father's Day: AI Now Reading Sperm, Giving Hope of Fatherhood to Infertile Men
Dr. PGL Lalit Kumar, Head of Embryology and Scientific Director, Nova IVF Fertility

AI is revolutionizing sperm analysis in fertility clinics by offering more accurate and consistent assessments. While AI aids in identifying rare sperm cells and improving treatment outcomes, experts stress it should complement, not replace, clinical expertise. The adoption of AI in fertility care is increasing, enhancing the precision and efficiency of evaluations.

This Men’s Health Month, it’s important to remember that a man’s health extends beyond just himself.

Physical health, emotional well-being, lifestyle habits, and reproductive health can all influence not only his own future, but also the well-being of his partner and the family he hopes to build.
Small everyday choices, timely health check-ups, and greater awareness can make a meaningful difference over time. Prioritising health today is also an investment in healthier tomorrows for the generations ahead.
At Nova IVF Fertility, we believe conversations around fertility and reproductive health should include men equally because awareness and early action matter for everyone involved.

Sometimes, supporting your fertility doesn’t require long hours at the gym, just a few intentional moments through the day. Even short bursts of movement can begin to make a difference to how your body responds

Exercise snacking,” or quick intervals of activity, is linked to better hormone balance, improved circulation, and lower stress levels. When done consistently, these small efforts can support your body more effectively than a sedentary routine.
At Nova IVF Fertility, we guide you towards simple, sustainable habits that work with your lifestyle, helping you move forward, one step at a time.

Around 15–20 eggs begin developing in your ovaries each month.

But the body naturally selects just one dominant egg and asks the rest to stop growing.
This is a normal biological process, not a limitation.
In IVF, this process is supported differently, allowing multiple eggs to continue developing for better chances of conception.
At Nova IVF Fertility, we believe awareness of your body helps you make more informed fertility choices.

Sometimes what feels like falling behind is just the body and mind taking a different path than expected.

There are moments in the fertility journey when things feel uncertain, when progress feels slow, and when answers do not come easily.
But with the right guidance, clarity slowly replaces confusion and support makes all the difference.

At Nova IVF Fertility, we focus on bringing structure to that uncertainty through informed decisions, scientific analysis, personalised support and expert guidance.

Difficulty conceiving a year after pregnancy loss often traces back to identifiable causes, uterine fibroids, polyps, or a septum obstructing implantation; thyroid disorders affecting both fertility and miscarriage risk; or luteal phase insufficiency where progesterone levels are inadequate to sustain the uterine lining. Each of these is investigable through targeted testing. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an IVF doctor in Ghatkopar, conducts this structured evaluation for patients who have not conceived within twelve months of loss.

Ovulatory dysfunction is among the most common causes of female infertility, when the ovaries fail to release an egg on schedule, often linked to PCOS or thyroid imbalance, there is simply no egg available for fertilisation that cycle. Blocked fallopian tubes and uterine abnormalities such as fibroids or polyps are the other leading structural causes. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an infertility specialist in Ghatkopar, investigates each of these systematically before recommending any treatment pathway.

Couples typically undergo two to three IUI cycles before their fertility specialist reassesses the treatment plan a single attempt rarely determines whether the approach is working for a given diagnosis. Research across millions of IVF births consistently shows no clinically significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of IVF-conceived children compared to those conceived naturally. From the point of uterine implantation, the developmental pathway is identical — the only difference in IVF is where fertilisation takes place. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF specialist in Ghatkopar, addresses health outcome concerns at every consultation before any treatment decision is made.

Uterine structural issues polyps, submucosal fibroids, and intrauterine adhesions — can sit undetected on standard ultrasound and silently fail transfers with good-quality embryos until a hysteroscopy is performed. The ERA test identifies a displaced implantation window in approximately 25% of patients with repeated failure, shifting transfer timing by a full day or more. An IVF doctor in Ghatkopar, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre conducts a full case review after every failed transfer before any next step is confirmed.

IUI bypasses the cervical stage of natural conception entirely — washed, concentrated sperm are placed directly into the uterine cavity through a thin catheter timed to coincide with confirmed ovulation. In natural conception, sperm must navigate the cervix independently, a process that filters out a significant proportion. The procedure takes under 10 minutes without anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre provides IUI Treatment in Ghatkopar following a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is started.

Chromosomal abnormality rates in embryos rise sharply with maternal age — at 40, more than half of embryos may be aneuploid even when morphology appears normal on visual grading. As an IVF specialist in Ghatkopar, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre applies PGT-A only when the clinical indication is clear — not as a default recommendation for all patients undergoing treatment.

AMH measures ovarian reserve but says nothing directly about egg quality or pregnancy likelihood. What it does tell a fertility specialist is how the ovaries will respond to stimulation and what dosage to begin with. Normal AMH ranges vary significantly by age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30, dropping to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. featured_reviews.review_text:
While trying to conceive, we had been through all the regular routes, homeopathy, ayurveda, HRT, IUI. Something about IVF made us feel that maybe it wasn’t the best way ahead for us. But the truth is, we probably needed to get to it sooner to save ourselves the prolonged disappointment and get closure either-way.

I believe we met Dr. Anand at the right time in our lives, thanks to friends of ours who had just delivered their babies under his care. We were immediately put at ease when we met him. Unlike some of the biggest doctors we met, who put me through some very unnecessary and discouraging tests, Dr.Anand asked us to put all that in the back burner & start afresh with complete faith. He was always very realistic and practical about the options and odds he presented us with. No false promises, no pessimism either.

He caught something in one of my reports that no one else had so far and with a small procedure we took care of it and marched towards our transfer. We were blessed to have conceived in our first attempt. It was such a surreal and special moment.

But the journey didn’t get any easier. I had minor bleeding incidents in the first trimester & Dr. Anand was always accessible and responsive in administering the best protocol to safeguard the pregnancy. In the 22nd week, after everything seemed under control, I went to visit my family in Chennai. During that time, some odd symptoms pushed me to go for a Scan where we found out that I was almost fully dilated and had to be taken in for an emergency cerclage & pessary placement. All these words just flew over my head. But something kept me very calm and strong, I knew I had to keep it together for the baby and not make things worse by panicking. Dr. Anand was very involved right from talking to the radiologist to finding out about the doctor who would be performing the procedure. The recovery period was very tense & we always had him in our corner any time we wanted to understand the situation better.

I was on modified bed rest for the remainder of the pregnancy during which, I only practiced gratitude for having come this far and having caught things at the right time. Thanks to the best medical care, family and an extraordinary husband who dint let me worry about anything, I completed 37 weeks and delivered my baby through an elective C-sec. It will be one of my most humbling achievements as the odds of this happening were bleak and each passing day post the cerclage was a bonus. I was overcome with resilience along with complete surrender. It’s a special state of mind to lock into and I wish to carry this strength forward.

We wholeheartedly thank Dr. Anand for giving us the beautiful gift that is our daughter. His passion shone in the way he tailor made our protocol for us, screened every report with a fine tooth comb while projecting a spirit that kept things light & in perspective. We love you. This was not possible without you, your care and your expertise.

Ekta & Ninad

featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with Dr. Anand has been incredible. I am 41 and have just been blessed with a baby girl delivered by Dr. Anand through IVF procedure.

At advanced maternal age, after 2 miscarriages, existing adenomyosis/endometriosis and with potentially poor quality of eggs due to medical history, I was certain of not just relying on trial and error through natural conception. We knew IVF was the way forward for us.

We tried IVF procedure at other clinics and met many doctors before making this critical decision of trusting Dr. Anand with our journey.

IVF procedure requires a lot of time, patience and commitment from both doctor and patient - I underwent 3 IVF cycles to finally achieve 4 usable embryos at Dr. Anand’s clinic. I also underwent medically induced menopause and hysteroscopy to reduce the impact of pre-existing adenomyosis/endometriosis before we went ahead with embryo transfer. Successful conception happened in the 2nd cycle of embryo transfer. The IVF medications continued till end of 4th month to support the pregnancy.

It was physically, emotionally, mentally and financially demanding journey. We completely trusted Dr. Anand's expertise and he has been our guide through this journey.

What was great during this journey ?
We have been with Benzer and Dr. Anand since 2023 and he was always available at all times and promptly and patiently answered all our queries. He would spend time with us explaining every step of journey and gently guiding us through the steps - right from the medications to the injections to the final delivery,  he was with us. This really helps as our treatment was complex and each patient believes they are different.

What you should be prepared for ?
Patience, Mental Strength and Faith - This is a journey with lots of ups and downs but the reward at the end of this journey would be that sweet bundle of happiness you call your own.

owner_posts.post_text: Most women who freeze eggs use them within a few years rather than at the full ten-year legal limit, with timing driven by career, health, or relationship readiness rather than a biological urgency to retrieve sooner. A full diagnostic workup following twelve months of failed conception after miscarriage typically begins with AMH testing, a thyroid panel, pelvic ultrasound, and semen analysis covering both partners rather than assuming the cause lies with one. Accurate ovulation tracking through follicular monitoring or LH testing also informs the clinical picture. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, structures this evaluation as the standard first step for couples in this situation.

Lifestyle factors including smoking, excess alcohol, chronic stress, and inadequate sleep affect fertility in both men and women, compounding the impact of any underlying medical cause already present. None of these factors alone typically explains infertility, but their combined effect is measurable. As an infertility specialist in Mumbai, Dr. Mohit Saraogi addresses modifiable lifestyle factors alongside structured diagnostic testing during every fertility consultation.

Ovulation monitoring through blood tests and ultrasound scans ensures IUI is timed accurately to the fertile window, which directly affects the likelihood of successful fertilisation in a given cycle. This monitoring is conducted throughout both natural and medicated IUI protocols. Dr. Mohit Saraogi, providing IUI Treatment in Mumbai, builds this monitoring into every treatment cycle, adjusting timing based on each patient's individual ovulatory response rather than a fixed calendar schedule.

IVF healthcare is a coordinated clinical process — ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval under ultrasound guidance, laboratory fertilisation through IVF or ICSI, embryo culture to blastocyst stage, and timed uterine transfer — supported throughout by hormonal monitoring, diagnostic review, and personalised protocol adjustments. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, builds each treatment plan around individual diagnostic findings rather than a generalised fertility protocol.

Research across millions of IVF births shows no significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of children conceived through IVF compared to those conceived naturally. Concerns about IVF babies' health persist largely because they are not consistently addressed at the consultation stage. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, where an IVF doctor in Mumbai, integrates clear, evidence-based health outcome discussions into every patient consultation before any cycle is recommended or initiated.

AMH reflects the quantity of remaining follicles in the ovaries, but its clinical significance depends entirely on the patient's age — a reading of 1.2 ng/mL means something very different at 29 than at 41. Normal reference ranges shift with age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30 years, narrowing to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre interprets AMH alongside antral follicle count and prior stimulation response before finalising any fertility treatment approach.

IUI involves processing a semen sample in the laboratory to concentrate motile sperm, then placing them directly into the uterus via a thin catheter timed to coincide with ovulation — eliminating the cervical barrier that filtered sperm must otherwise navigate in natural conception. The procedure takes under 10 minutes and requires no anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre offers IUI Treatment in Mumbai with ovulation monitoring and a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is recommended.

PGT-A screens IVF embryos for chromosomal abnormalities before transfer — identifying which embryos have the correct chromosome count and reducing the risk of failed implantation and miscarriage in high-risk groups. It is most clinically relevant for women over 37, those with recurrent miscarriage, and patients with repeated implantation failure despite good-quality embryos. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital recommends PGT-A based on case history and failure pattern, not as a routine add-on.

Around 15–20 eggs begin developing in your ovaries each month.

Many couples believe that having a regular menstrual cycle guarantees regular ovulation. However, regular periods don't always mean regular ovulation, and hidden fertility issues can still exist behind the scenes.

If you have been trying to conceive without success, an early evaluation can help identify subtle hormonal or structural factors that might be affecting conception. Taking a proactive approach allows for a personalized care plan to help improve your chances.

Key Takeaways for Couples:
• Regular periods don't guarantee regular ovulation.
• Hidden fertility issues can affect conception silently.
• Early evaluation helps in accurate diagnosis.
• Personalized care improves your chances.

Don't guess when it comes to your reproductive health. Get a complete fertility evaluation.

Uterine fibroids are benign, non-cancerous growths that develop within or around the muscular walls of the uterus. While many women with fibroids conceive without medical intervention, certain types can influence fertility.

Depending on their size, number, and location, fibroids can:
• Alter the shape of the uterine cavity, impacting embryo implantation.
• Restrict optimal blood circulation to the uterine lining.
• Obstruct the fallopian tubes.

At Embrion IVF Center, we assess each case individually. If a fibroid is affecting your fertility, modern, minimally invasive management can restore optimal uterine health before starting treatment.

If you have faced repeated embryo implantation failure despite transferring high-quality embryos, immune factors within the reproductive tract may be a contributing factor worth investigating.

Natural Killer (NK) cells are a standard, protective component of the body's immune system. However, an imbalance of these cells within the uterine lining can sometimes affect how the body responds to an embryo, impacting its ability to implant safely.

Through advanced reproductive immunological testing, our laboratory can evaluate these cell levels and implement targeted therapeutic options to foster a more receptive environment.
